# Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria: The Iceberg Under the Surface

> Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria isn't simply a matter of "feeling sensitive." It can be a source of extreme emotional pain, and it's a common though lesser-known symptom of ADHD.
